items.title: Is the Anthropic IPO the only thing that matters for the rest of 2026?
items.summary: Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on which events in the last two months of 2026 are the most pivotal for the markets: Nvidia's (NVDA) Nov. 17 earnings, the Federal Reserve's December decision, or whether Anthropic goes public.Today's panel includes Hennion & Walsh CIO Kevin Mahn, Neostellar Principal Willy Lee, Grenadilla Advisory Founder and CEO Anna Rathbun, and Futurum Chief Market Strategist Shay Boloor.

items.title: Could Micron Technology (MU) Face Slower AI Demand From New Data Center Rules?
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS:MU) faces fresh uncertainty after the latest U.S. midterm elections shifted control of key congressional committees. Newly empowered lawmakers are backing proposals for tighter federal rules on AI data centers, including stricter zoning, power use and water permits. Policy advocates are also promoting environmental review requirements that could extend project timelines for large AI facilities in multiple states.
